Text: Architectural services for the design and delivery of a new two-storey dwelling, garage, landscape coordination and pool interface. Services include consultant coordination, planning documentation, construction documentation and periodic construction-phase services.

Structural engineering for footings, reinforced concrete slab, steelwork, timber framing, retaining elements and pool-shell interface. Civil services cover roof-water discharge, site drainage interfaces and driveway levels. This proposal relies on a geotechnical report to be obtained by the client.

Hydraulic engineering for potable water, sanitary drainage, stormwater drainage, rainwater reuse and pool backwash interfaces. Services include coordination with architectural and structural documentation, a stormwater concept and construction-phase clarification.

The proposal assumes one development application pathway, a conventional procurement process and a 14-month construction period. Landscape design, interior decoration and pool engineering are excluded unless separately agreed.

Geotechnical investigation, survey, pool engineering, hydraulic design, stormwater authority fees, inspection work beyond four scheduled inspections, redesign after client changes and builder shop-drawing production are excluded.

**To:** Kavanagh Property Holdings Pty Ltd as trustee for the Kavanagh Family Trust
**Project:** Kavanagh Residence — new detached dwelling and external works
**Site:** 8 Paperbark Lane, Northbridge NSW 2063
Lift design, fire engineering, acoustic reports and pool engineering are excluded from this fee.
